data.name: Devastating Brand
data.description: When the kinslayer attacks a creature that she has branded with her slayer's brand, she threatens a critical hit on a roll of 19-20. If the kinslayer is good, she also gains a +2 sacred bonus on all rolls to confirm critical hits on a branded creature.
